title: Monster
description:
A creature/enemy. Each monster has exactly one element (Wuxing five-phase) that governs how phased effects interact with it via data/wuxing. Its attacks and innate abilities are drawn from the shared effect registry through schema.json#/definitions/appliedEffect, exactly like spells and consumables. Certain monsters with living spiritual or elemental essence can also drop spirit cores (see coreDrop); undead and humanoids must never have coreDrop.

Supports a Base + Override pattern: entries may either be flat monsters (all fields inline) or reference a base template and provide only overrides. Base templates live in bases/*.json and are resolved at validation/load time.

monsterData.description: Shared data shape used by both flat monster entries and overrides. All fields are optional here; requiredness is enforced at the entry level.

label.description: Human-readable display name with spaces and capitalization.

phase.description: The monster's element. Required — every monster has exactly one. Determines elemental affinity: incoming phased effects resolve against it through the generating/overcoming/weakening/insulting cycles in data/wuxing.

attributes.description: The eight attributes (1-10), keyed by ability id. Optional; engines derive missing values from level.

hitPoints.description: Authored baseline HP; engines may derive from END + level.

abilities.description: The monster's attacks and innate powers, drawn from the shared effect registry (data/effects). A monster typically wields effects of its own phase, but need not.

coreDropShape.description: If present, this monster can drop a spirit core on death. **Hard rule**: undead and humanoids must never have this field. Only monsters with genuine living spiritual or elemental essence may include it.

monster.description: A fully self-contained monster entry with all required fields inline.

key.description: Symbolic snake_case key (the old string id) for human readability when editing JSON.

label.description: Human-readable display name with spaces and capitalization.

attributes.description: The eight attributes (1-10), keyed by ability id.

abilities.description: The monster's attacks and innate powers.

monsterWithBase.description: A monster entry that references a base template and provides only overrides. The base is resolved at load time from bases/<base>.json and merged with overrides (override wins). This keeps core.json lean and enables easy variant creation.

base.description: Name of the base template in bases/<name>.json (without .json suffix). Base templates provide default values; overrides replace them.
